newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, nearbys weaker.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, nearbys weaker.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Thursday in lacklustre trade, as private investors were generally sidelined ahead of the spot expiry on Monday, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.5 yen per kg lower to 0.2 yen firmer. Benchmark April was 0.2 yen up at 143.3 yen.

Nearby months edged lower on long liquidation ahead of the spot expiry, while buying on dips sent distant months barely into positive territory. "We expect the spot November contract to expire between 130.0 yen and 135.0 yen," one trader said.
